basis: January 31, 2024 is the earliest qualifying disclosure I could verify. Heartland reported consolidated Q4 2023 GAAP operating revenue, including fuel surcharges, of $275,347,000 versus $354,923,000 in Q4 2022, a 22.42% decline. The 95% cutoff was $337,176,850. The earliest date remains unresolved because Heartland announced two earlier management conference appearances, and I could verify the notices but could not locate slides, recordings or transcripts establishing what management said at either event.

coverage.detail: The February 3, 2023 release identifies Q4 2022 as the first full quarter consolidating Heartland Express, Millis Transfer, Smith Transport and CFI. Both fourth quarters therefore include a full quarter of the acquired carriers.
The July 31 Q2 release reported $306.2 million in quarterly operating revenue. Management discussed freight demand and operating-ratio improvement without giving a numerical Q4 revenue outlook.
Heartland announced that its CEO and CFO would participate in Morgan Stanley’s September 12 Laguna Conference. The notice gives no Q4 revenue figure. The management remarks remain unverified.

The October 26 Q3 release reported $295.0 million in quarterly revenue and $932.1 million through September. Management described weak freight demand and its decision to exit unprofitable lanes. It gave no numerical Q4 consolidated revenue bound.
Heartland announced that management would present at Baird’s November 7 Global Industrial Conference. The notice contains no Q4 revenue estimate. The presentation itself remains unverified.

The November 9 Q3 Form 10-Q reports nine-month operating revenue of $932,111,000. Its numerical outlook addresses capital spending and equipment-disposal gains. As a secondary check, subsequently reported full-year revenue of $1,207,458,000 less $932,111,000 equals the published Q4 actual of $275,347,000.

The November 14 Regulation FD filing estimated a $25 million pretax gain from the November 10 sale of three terminal properties. The Q4 income statement classifies the gain within operating expenses, separately from operating revenue.

Between the Q3 and Q4 releases, Heartland’s news archive lists the Baird conference notice, a November 21 dividend of $0.02 per share and a December veterans announcement. I found no preliminary Q4 revenue release or updated revenue range.

The January 31 release directly tabulates operating revenue for the three months ended December 31, in thousands of dollars, as 275,347 for 2023 and 354,923 for 2022. The separate fuel-surcharge-excluded figures are non-GAAP.
Item 2.02 confirms that Heartland announced the quarter and year-end results on January 31. The Form 8-K was signed February 2.

publication_date_evidence: The actual-results exhibit is dated January 31, 2024 and marked “For Immediate Release.” Both Heartland’s press archive and Item 2.02 of its February 2 Form 8-K independently identify January 31 as the public announcement date. The dollar value above is the verified quarterly actual.
